summary.text: Sean Frame is the Democratic candidate for California State Senate District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Roger Niello.
He works as an education specialist.

paragraphs.text: Sean Frame earned a bachelor's degree from San Jose State University and a graduate degree from San Francisco State University.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he ran his own small business for nearly 30 years before taking a job creating multimedia materials for educators who test English learners and students with disabilities for the Sacramento County Board of Education, where he said he is a shop steward for CSEA Local 480.
Frame advanced from the June 2, 2026 nonpartisan primary for State Senate District 6, defeating Sara Velasco for the second general-election spot.
In the 2024 survey, he named housing and support for unhoused residents, including a state declaration of emergency on housing, and addressing climate change as his top priorities.
